records.context: Walk a dropped folder ONCE and return the folder-metadata report.
records.label: spacr.qt.dnd_handlers.scan_folder_structure#0
records.source: Walk a dropped folder ONCE and return the folder-metadata report.
records.translation: Percorre uma pasta recebida por arrastar e soltar uma única vez e retorna o relatório de metadados da pasta.

records.context: Worker-safe: plain data in, plain data out, nothing Qt. The single walk is the point. This replaced three walks of the same tree — ``detect_folder_metadata`` did one, ``plan_folder_extraction`` did another and called ``detect_folder_metadata`` again for a third — all on the main GUI execution path, all inside the drop event.
records.label: spacr.qt.dnd_handlers.scan_folder_structure#1
records.source: Worker-safe: plain data in, plain data out, nothing Qt. The single walk is the point. This replaced three walks of the same tree — ``detect_folder_metadata`` did one, ``plan_folder_extraction`` did another and called ``detect_folder_metadata`` again for a third — all on the GUI thread, all inside the drop event.
records.translation: Seguro para execução em uma thread de trabalho: entram dados simples, saem dados simples e não há Qt. O objetivo é efetuar um único percurso. Isto substituiu três percursos da mesma árvore — ``detect_folder_metadata`` fez um, ``plan_folder_extraction`` fez outro e chamou novamente ``detect_folder_metadata`` para um terceiro —, todos na via principal de execução da GUI e dentro do evento de arrastar e soltar.

records.context: The probe consumes 30 entries from *the generator later consumed by the planner*. An unrecognized folder therefore costs only 30 files rather than a complete traversal.
records.label: spacr.qt.dnd_handlers.scan_folder_structure#2
records.source: The probe is pulled off the *same* lazy generator the planner then drains, so a folder whose layout is not recognisable costs 30 files, not a traversal.
records.translation: A sonda retira 30 entradas *do mesmo gerador diferido que o planejador esgota depois*. Assim, uma pasta cuja estrutura não seja reconhecida custa apenas 30 arquivos, não um percurso completo.

records.source: One ``sqlite_master`` query; the table screens make the same one when they load. Kept here so the drop can *ask* which table rather than let ``load_path`` take the first one silently.
records.translation: Uma consulta a ``sqlite_master``; as vistas de tabela do aplicativo fazem a mesma consulta quando são carregadas. Mantém-se aqui para que, ao soltar o arquivo, se possa *perguntar* qual tabela usar, em vez de permitir que ``load_path`` escolha silenciosamente a primeira.

records.context: Opened read-only, and through a *quoted* URI: a folder with a ``?`` or a ``#`` in its name would otherwise have everything after it read as query parameters, and the open would fail on a database that is perfectly fine.
records.label: spacr.qt.dnd_handlers.table_names#2
records.source: Opened read-only, and through a *quoted* URI: a folder with a ``?`` or a ``#`` in its name would otherwise have everything after it read as query parameters, and the open would fail on a database that is perfectly fine.
records.translation: É aberto em modo somente leitura e por meio de um URI *codificado*: caso contrário, em uma pasta com ``?`` ou ``#`` no nome, tudo o que viesse depois seria interpretado como parâmetros de consulta, e a abertura falharia em um banco de dados perfeitamente válido.

records.translation: caminho candidato de um banco de dados SQLite para inspeção em modo somente leitura.

records.context: A cut on one column — the line dragged across a histogram.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.ThresholdGate#0
records.source: A cut on one column — the line dragged across a histogram.
records.translation: Um corte em uma coluna — a linha arrastada sobre um histograma.

records.context: ``None`` on a bound means unbounded on that side, which is what a threshold dragged to the edge should mean rather than "exclude everything". At least one bound is required: a data-selection boundary with neither is the whole population, and naming that is a way to lose track of it.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.ThresholdGate#1
records.source: ``None`` on a bound means unbounded on that side, which is what a threshold dragged to the edge should mean rather than "exclude everything". At least one bound is required: a gate with neither is the whole population, and naming that is a way to lose track of it.
records.translation: ``None`` em um limite significa que esse lado não é delimitado, que é o que um limiar arrastado até a borda deve significar em vez de "excluir tudo". Pelo menos um limite é necessário: um limite de seleção de dados sem nenhum dos dois abrangeria toda a população, e nomeá-lo facilitaria perdê-lo de vista.

records.context: name of the data-selection boundary containing this one, or ``None`` for a root data-selection boundary.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.ThresholdGate#3
records.source: name of the gate containing this one, or ``None`` for a root gate.
records.translation: nome do limite de seleção de dados que contém este, ou ``None`` para um limite raiz.

records.context: One anchor per bound, at the middle of the view's height.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.ThresholdGate.handles#0
records.source: One anchor per bound, at the middle of the view's height.
records.translation: Um ponto de controle por limite, no meio da altura da vista.

records.context: An unbounded side gets no handle. A threshold with no upper bound is open to infinity, and an anchor at the edge of the view would look like a bound the data-selection boundary does not have -- the user would drag it and discover they had just invented one.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.ThresholdGate.handles#1
records.source: An unbounded side gets no handle. A threshold with no upper bound is open to infinity, and an anchor at the edge of the view would look like a bound the gate does not have -- the user would drag it and discover they had just invented one.
records.translation: Um lado não delimitado não recebe ponto de controle. Um limiar sem limite superior se estende até o infinito; uma âncora na borda da vista pareceria um limite inexistente na seleção de dados. O usuário a arrastaria e descobriria que acabara de criar um.

records.context: visible ``(x_low, x_high, y_low, y_high)`` limits used to place each bound handle vertically.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.ThresholdGate.handles#2
records.source: visible ``(x_low, x_high, y_low, y_high)`` limits used to place each bound handle vertically.
records.translation: limites visíveis ``(x_low, x_high, y_low, y_high)`` usados para posicionar verticalmente o ponto de controle de cada limite.

records.context: one handle for every finite bound.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.ThresholdGate.handles#3
records.source: one handle for every finite bound.
records.translation: um ponto de controle por cada limite finito.

records.context: measurement table containing this data-selection boundary's column.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.ThresholdGate.mask#1
records.source: measurement table containing this gate's column.
records.translation: tabela de medições que contém a coluna deste limite de seleção de dados.

records.context: ``dy`` is ignored: a threshold is a cut on ONE column, so it has no second axis to move along.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.ThresholdGate.translated#0
records.source: ``dy`` is ignored: a threshold is a cut on ONE column, so it has no second axis to move along.
records.translation: ``dy`` é ignorado: um limiar é um corte em uma única coluna, portanto não possui um segundo eixo ao longo do qual se mover.

records.context: displacement to add to each finite threshold bound.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.ThresholdGate.translated#1
records.source: displacement to add to each finite threshold bound.
records.translation: deslocamento que será adicionado a cada limite finito do limiar.

records.context: measurement column whose bounds are being changed; a different column is rejected because this data-selection boundary cannot represent it.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.ThresholdGate.with_threshold#1
records.source: measurement column whose bounds are being changed; a different column is rejected because this gate cannot represent it.
records.translation: coluna de medição cujos limites estão sendo alterados; uma coluna diferente é rejeitada porque este limite de seleção de dados não pode representá-la.
